lines.text: The root is Tend! Intend, attend, extend.
Did you know? Tend is Latin for stretch.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus stretch?

words.ex: I intend to finish the report this week.
More than a hundred people attended the meeting.
We decided to extend our holiday by two days.

publish.title: Tend root: intend, attend and extend
publish.value: Tend comes from Latin "tendere" (to stretch). Words: intend, attend and extend. intend = in + tend; attend = at + tend; extend = ex + tend.
